headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error pathways exist because Khoj reads local notes while Perplexity uploads documents and browses externally.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Khoj reads indexed personal notes/files, and Perplexity can ingest uploaded documents plus browsing context. If Perplexity content is copied into Khoj, or Khoj notes are pasted into Perplexity, attacker-controlled text can steer the other agent. This is not provably blocked by either profile, though the bridge is indirect rather than native.
conditions: IF Perplexity output is copied into Khoj notes or chat
IF Khoj indexed notes contain untrusted instructions that Perplexity later summarizes
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Do not paste raw outputs from one agent into the other
Mark imported notes as untrusted before indexing
Use a human review step before acting on quoted instructions
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to transferred content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj reads local personal notes and indexed documents, while Perplexity accepts uploaded documents and sends queries to vendor-hosted search/API surfaces. In a pair workflow, sensitive notes can move from Khoj into Perplexity uploads or prompts, creating exfiltration risk beyond a single local workspace. The closed-source vendor-hosted side increases uncertainty, so severity stays high.
conditions: IF personal notes from Khoj are uploaded to Perplexity
IF Perplexity is used on documents containing secrets or private notes
mitigations: Do not upload sensitive notes to Perplexity
Redact secrets before cross-agent transfer
Use separate accounts for each agent
Restrict Perplexity to non-sensitive public material
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on uploads

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Khoj has read-only filesystem access and no write or git mutation, while Perplexity has no filesystem write and no host execution. Their write-capability overlap is therefore minimal, so direct resource conflict is unlikely. The main interaction is through content exchange, not competing mutations of the same mutable state.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable directory through an external orchestrator
IF an external system grants either agent write access not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only on shared data
Avoid mounting the same writable directory into both agents
Use separate git worktrees if files must be edited
Review any external orchestration permissions
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity produces cited answers from browsing/search, and Khoj is a retrieval assistant over personal notes. If one agent’s output is fed into the other without verification, errors or hallucinations can cascade into apparently grounded answers. Neither profile shows a built-in verification gate between them, so the pathway exists in default usage patterns.
conditions: IF Perplexity answers are imported into Khoj as trusted notes
IF Khoj summaries are used as source material for Perplexity without checking originals
mitigations: Verify claims against original sources before reuse
Keep a source-link back to the originating document
Do not auto-ingest one agent’s output into the other
Use a checklist for factual claims before acting
requires-engineering: add citation-preserving handoff metadata

E_compliance.rationale: Khoj touches personal notes and indexed documents, while Perplexity touches search queries, uploaded documents, and browsing context under vendor-hosted processing. If the same regulated data class is moved from local notes into Perplexity uploads or browsing context, retention and residency obligations can diverge. The profiles do not show matching compliance controls, so the mismatch is plausible.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is uploaded from Khoj into Perplexity
IF the data subject requires deletion or residency guarantees across both services
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated data to Perplexity
Classify notes before cross-service use
Use a separate non-regulated workspace for Perplexity
Check vendor retention settings before upload
requires-engineering: document a data-handling policy for both tools
